microtheory.name: music_production
microtheory.definition: Recording, mixing, mastering, signal flow, gear. The craft of capturing + shaping sound for delivery. Microphones, preamps, EQ, compression, reverb, delay, automation. Substrate analogue: the substrate's audio output pipeline + the input-conditioning equivalents.

concepts.name: microphone
concepts.definition: Transducer converting acoustic pressure to electrical signal. Dynamic, condenser, ribbon. Substrate analogue: substrate's input transducer.

concepts.name: dynamic_microphone
concepts.definition: Moving coil in magnetic field. Rugged, no power needed. Drums + loud sources. Substrate analogue: substrate's loud-source-tolerant input.

concepts.name: condenser_microphone
concepts.definition: Capacitive element. Sensitive, wide-bandwidth. Requires phantom power. Vocals + instruments. Substrate analogue: substrate's sensitive input.

concepts.name: polar_pattern
concepts.definition: Microphone directional response. Omnidirectional, cardioid, supercardioid, figure-8. Substrate analogue: substrate's input-direction filter.

concepts.name: proximity_effect
concepts.definition: Cardioid microphones boost low frequencies when close to source. Substrate analogue: substrate's distance-dependent spectral coloring.

concepts.name: stereo_pair
concepts.definition: Two microphones positioned for stereo image. ORTF, XY, AB, Blumlein. Substrate analogue: substrate's bilateral input.

concepts.name: signal_flow
concepts.definition: The path audio travels from source to output. Mic → preamp → A/D → DAW → D/A → monitors. Substrate analogue: substrate's audio pipeline graph.

concepts.name: preamp
concepts.definition: Amplifies mic signal to line level. Coloring (tube, transformer) or transparent. Substrate analogue: substrate's input-gain stage.

concepts.name: line_level
concepts.definition: Standard audio level. +4 dBu pro, -10 dBV consumer. Substrate analogue: substrate's normalized internal signal level.

concepts.name: gain_staging
concepts.definition: Setting levels appropriately at each stage to maintain SNR + avoid clipping. Substrate analogue: substrate's per-stage signal normalization.

concepts.name: headroom
concepts.definition: Margin between operating level + clipping. Allows transient peaks without distortion. Substrate analogue: substrate's dynamic range margin.

concepts.name: equalization
concepts.definition: Frequency-selective gain. Cuts or boosts specific frequency bands. Substrate analogue: substrate's spectral shaping.

concepts.name: parametric_eq
concepts.definition: EQ with controllable frequency, gain, Q. Most flexible. Substrate analogue: substrate's parameterized filter bank.

concepts.name: compression_mixing
concepts.definition: Dynamics: reduce signal when above threshold by ratio. Threshold, ratio, attack, release, knee, makeup gain. Substrate analogue: substrate's gain-control with envelope.

concepts.name: reverb_processing
concepts.definition: Adds simulated room sound. Convolution (real impulse responses) or algorithmic (plate, hall, spring). Substrate analogue: substrate's spatial-context emulation.

concepts.name: delay_effect
concepts.definition: Single or repeating echoes. Substrate analogue: substrate's temporal-shift signal duplication.

concepts.name: panning
concepts.definition: Stereo placement: how loud in left vs right. Substrate analogue: substrate's bilateral-channel signal distribution.

concepts.name: automation
concepts.definition: Time-varying control of parameters. Volume rides, EQ sweeps. Substrate analogue: substrate's parameterized signal evolution.

concepts.name: side_chain
concepts.definition: External signal triggering processing. Ducking — bass duck for kick. Substrate analogue: substrate's cross-signal modulation.

concepts.name: mastering
concepts.definition: Final processing for delivery. Balances, EQ, compression, limiting, loudness, sequencing. Substrate analogue: substrate's output-finalization stage.

concepts.name: loudness_war
concepts.definition: Industry trend of increasingly compressed + limited masters for perceived loudness. Reduces dynamic range. Substrate analogue: substrate's over-compression failure mode.

concepts.name: lufs
concepts.definition: Loudness Units Full Scale — perceptual loudness measurement. Streaming targets ~-14 LUFS. Substrate analogue: substrate's perceptual-loudness output target.

concepts.name: true_peak
concepts.definition: Inter-sample peak that can exceed digital sample peaks. Should not exceed -1 dBTP for streaming. Substrate analogue: substrate's safe output ceiling.

concepts.name: monitor_speakers
concepts.definition: Reference speakers for accurate listening during production. Substrate analogue: substrate's calibrated output reference.

concepts.name: headphones_production
concepts.definition: Closed-back for tracking; open-back for mixing. Substrate analogue: substrate's near-field reference.

concepts.name: room_treatment
concepts.definition: Absorbers + diffusers + bass traps to make a room neutral. Substrate analogue: substrate's environment-correction for evaluation.

concepts.name: daw
concepts.definition: Digital Audio Workstation. Pro Tools, Logic, Ableton, Reaper. Software hub for production. Substrate analogue: substrate's audio-production interface.

concepts.name: vst_au_plugin
concepts.definition: Plugin formats: VST (cross-platform), AU (Mac), AAX (ProTools). Substrate analogue: substrate's audio-effect dispatch.

rules.name: gain_staging_prevents_noise_and_distortion
rules.head: the substrate processes audio through multiple stages
rules.body: each stage should operate near nominal level — too low loses SNR to noise floor, too high causes distortion. Substrate's per-stage normalization.

rules.name: headroom_required_for_transients
rules.head: the substrate records or processes dynamic audio
rules.body: leave headroom (typically 6-12 dB) for transient peaks above the average level. Substrate's dynamic margin.

rules.name: stereo_pair_choice_affects_image
rules.head: the substrate captures stereo audio
rules.body: the microphone arrangement (XY, ORTF, AB, etc.) trades off localization accuracy vs spaciousness. Substrate's bilateral capture choice.

rules.name: compression_controls_dynamics
rules.head: the substrate processes signals with wide dynamic range
rules.body: compression reduces the range. Threshold + ratio + timing parameters shape the effect. Substrate's dynamic-range controller.

rules.name: mastering_finalizes_for_target_medium
rules.head: the substrate prepares audio for delivery
rules.body: the master must meet the target medium's loudness + spectral + dynamic standards. Substrate's output adaptation.
